test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain sum is invested on compound interest at 18% per annum for 1 year 4 months, the interest being compounded 8-monthly. If the compound interest is Rs. 3,816, then find the sum (in Rs.).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Rate of Interest** for 8 months = (18 / 12) × 8 = 12%

Number of **time periods** = 16 months ÷ 8 months = 2

Effective CI percentage for 2 periods = 12 + 12 + (12 × 12 / 100) = 25.44%

25.44% of Sum = ₹3,816 ⇒ 100% of Sum = (3816 / 25.44) × 100 = ₹15,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Rate (R) = 18% p.a., Time = 1 year 4 months = 16 months, CI = ₹3,816, Compounding = 8-monthly.

**Formula:** CI = P[(1 + r/100)ⁿ − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5f78bb028feb8997e55591a60521b73082d7bf11ff864ffacbb47ffa0d7de42.png] 

⇒ Effective Rate (r) = 18% × (8/12) = 12% per period

⇒ Number of periods (n) = 16 / 8 = 2

⇒ 3816 = P[(1 + 12/100)² − 1]

⇒ 3816 = P[(1.12)² − 1]

⇒ 3816 = P[1.2544 − 1]

⇒ 3816 = P × 0.2544

⇒ P = 3816 ÷ 0.2544

⇒ P = 15,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compounding

When interest is compounded k-monthly, the rate becomes (R/12) × k and time periods become (T × 12)/k.

CI for 2 Periods

For two equal periods of rate r%, the net effective percentage is r + r + (r²/100)%.

Difference between CI and SI

For 2 years (or 2 periods), the difference is P(r/100)².
